notes: Bing returned HTTP 200 but no actual linkedin.com/in result anchors for the three company queries.
Google attempts were converted to status 0 because CrossLinked silently catches request exceptions; a separate diagnostic received an anti-automation style page with no anchors.
CrossLinked uses verify=False for search requests and has no reliable retry or backoff policy.

effect.false_positive_rate_note: No candidates were returned, so precision and false-positive rate cannot be measured.

offline_parser_check.input: A synthetic direct LinkedIn profile anchor with name and title
offline_parser_check.note: The anchor parser still works for the historical expected HTML shape; the live search-engine acquisition layer is the failing boundary.

decision.recommendation: Do not integrate CrossLinked 0.3.0 or its subprocess into Key Search. The live Google/Bing acquisition path returned zero candidates and missed all three existing verified people.
decision.reusable_idea: The site:linkedin.com/in plus exact company-name query pattern may still be reused through a maintained search provider, followed by the existing current-employment and contact-binding gates.
decision.reason: CrossLinked formats guessed account names; it does not verify employment, email ownership, deliverability, phone ownership, or contact-channel binding.
